title: fr.linagora.twalk.persona.suggest.produced.v1
description: A persona produced a suggested reply for human oversight. Nothing is ever sent on the sole basis of this event: a suggestion only becomes a reply when a persona.reply.approved event references it. Produced by Hermes on the NATS JetStream bus.

specversion.description: CloudEvents specification version. Fixed to 1.0 for all Twalk v1 events.

id.description: Deterministic identifier computed as sha256(persona_id + ':' + trigger_event_id + ':' + attempt), with attempt starting at 1. Several suggestions may exist for the same trigger; each attempt has its own id while remaining replay-safe.

source.description: URI identifying the persona that produced the suggestion. Format: hermes://<domain>/personas/<persona_id>.

type.description: CloudEvents type. Reverse-DNS convention with an explicit version suffix. Any breaking change to this schema requires incrementing the suffix (v2, v3, ...) rather than mutating v1.

time.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when Hermes produced the event.

subject.description: CloudEvents id of the trigger event the suggestion replies to.

datacontenttype.description: Fixed to application/json for all Twalk v1 events.

dataschema.description: Optional URI pointing back to this JSON Schema. Recommended for third-party consumers that validate events dynamically.

traceparent.description: Optional W3C Trace Context traceparent header, normally continued from the trigger event.

network.description: Twalk extension. Network of the trigger event, copied for server-side filtering on NATS without deserializing the data payload.

consent.description: Twalk extension. Consent state of the trigger event's sender, copied from the trigger.

persona_id.description: Identifier of the persona that produced the suggestion.

event_id.description: CloudEvents id of the trigger event. Identical to the top-level subject.

event_type.description: CloudEvents type of the trigger event.

trigger.description: Structured reference to the event the suggestion replies to.

body.description: The suggested reply in its canonical text form.

format.description: Content type of the body field. text/plain is the default and safest.

attempt.description: Suggestion number for this trigger, starting at 1. Part of the id natural key.

confidence.description: Optional self-reported confidence of the persona, for oversight display. Not a correctness guarantee.

rationale.description: Optional short explanation of why the persona suggests this reply, for oversight display.

expires_at.description: Optional RFC 3339 timestamp after which the suggestion should be considered stale (e.g. a same-day appointment answer).
